task_name: Cutover and restore scripts plus checklist
audit_input_note: T17 deliverables are git-ignored host files; audited by content hash, not git range

concerns_addressed: Hashes: all four files re-hashed and matched the expected values; cutover-ggf.sh is 641 lines.

Safe by default: rcmd, rout, lrun, remote_test_f and get_var are gated on EXECUTE=1. Dry-run, no-flag (the confirmation prompt aborts before any ssh), restore with no args and self-check all ran under the shim; the shim calls.log stayed at 0 bytes before and after. No remote command is reachable without --execute (no Critical).

Cycle-2 Important 1 (rc 255 dead branch) cleared: reproduced with a stubbed ssh at top level under the real set -Eeuo and ERR trap (not inside an if). rc 255 now reaches POINT=2 before validation and prints 'FAILURE POINT 2 ... Check the merge state FIRST'; the merge_started marker is kept. rc 0 with a failed check also gives point 2. The trap is cleared before the pipeline and re-armed after; PIPESTATUS[0] is read by the very next statement; no early return exists between 'trap - ERR' and 'trap on_err ERR'.

Cycle-2 Important 2 (merge_started wedging a retry) cleared: rc 1 reports point 1, removes merge_started.done, and prints the exact retry command. When the remote rm fails, the exact clear command is printed (reproduced with a failing stub). The reasoning for '--from-phase d' is correct: the point-1 recovery retags camel-server:latest to the old image, phase f snapshots and merges with the NEW image, and the old image's migrate.js would report 'copy skipped'; phase d reloads the new image and phase e re-stops the server, while --from-phase bypasses the phase markers. The checklist (lines 95-98) matches the script.

Cycle-2 Important 3 (dist swap && chain) cleared: swap_dist_script is plain sequential statements; the only removal is 'rm -rf -- <web>.next'. A failing cp or mv aborts under set -e in the remote RPRE. Final test -f, cmp -s of the staged vs live index.html, and test -d of the .replaced dir make a stale or missing dist fail. Re-run covers a failure after the first mv (live dir missing: elif copies the stage). No quoting or set -u hazard: the string has no variable expansion or special characters, and WEB_ROOT is a constant.

Mutations on scratch copies, each making self-check exit 1: (e') ERR-trap window removed fails 2 checks (rc 1 recovery, rc 255 wording); (g') && chain restored fails 2 checks (no-&& structural, failing cp drive); (a) '|| die' -> '|| true' fails 5 checks. The unmutated self-check prints 47 ok and PASS.

Self-check isolation: phase_f runs in subshells with rcmd/ssh/sub_marker_exists defined as shell functions, mktemp goes to TMPDIR=<self-check temp dir>, and the dist-swap drive uses a stubbed sudo/cp on PATH against paths under the self-check temp dir. No real ssh/sudo/cp against real paths; calls.log stayed empty.
Dry-run output matches what --execute sends for rcmd, rout, lrun, the merge command and the swap script (see Minor on marker order).
No IPs, secrets or env values in the four files.

strengths: The ERR-trap window around the merge pipeline is minimal and correct, and the exit code is classified before anything else runs.

Self-check now runs the real phase_f under production shell options (set -e and ERR trap armed, never in an if), with fixtures for rc 0, 1 and 255, plus a local dist-swap drive with a failing cp, happy path and re-run.
Never-re-merge guarantee is explicit (merge_started plus merge.done) and the automatic clear is limited to the rc != 0 and rc != 255 branch.
Old image, old dist and the .pre-merge copies are never deleted; the widened deletion ban in self-check covers rm -r/-fr/-rf/-R and docker rm.

issues.description: New. The automatic merge_started clear and 'nothing is committed' wording treat every rc other than 0 and 255 as a clean rollback, including rc >= 128 (signal-killed ssh, container OOM-kill) and an rc 1 from a COMMIT whose acknowledgement was lost (migrate.ts exits 1 on any thrown error). The point-1 text hedges ('if the output shows it may have COMMITTED, use point 2') but the marker is already cleared by then. Consider treating rc >= 128 like 255 and leaving the marker.
New. Dry-run prints 'sub_mark merge_started' after the merge command line, but --execute writes it before the merge. Order in the dry-run listing is inverted relative to the real run.
New. self_check assigns globals (rc, got, code, swap_script) instead of locals; harmless today because self-check exits, but fragile if the function is ever reused.

Carried forward, unfixed. Backup row-count equality against LIVE data while the site is still serving traffic can false-abort (card_events grows on every mutation). Consider requiring cards and tracker_items equal and restored events <= live.

Carried forward, unfixed. The terminate, rename-aside and rename-new steps are separate -c transactions; an interruption between them leaves no database under the production name and the re-run's first rename fails, contradicting 'every step is re-runnable'.
Carried forward, unfixed. Phase c's 'test -e <copy> || sudo cp -a ...' leaves a partial copy that later counts as present if cp is interrupted; the same for the compose backup copy on the next line.

Carried forward, unfixed. '--from-phase' or '--date' as the last argument hits a bare second shift and exits through the ERR trap with an unhelpful message; '--from-phase ' silently behaves as no flag. MIN_FREE_MB=1024 vs ~846 MB free means preflight aborts today (correct fail-safe, T18 item).
